scope: Fresh source asset-backed near/middle templates and retained procedural-pine controls replayed with actual cutouts and maximum instance scales. The parent must reproduce every published template and the hinted candidate must match the dense candidate. Only empty coarse alpha patterns get a finer positive-witness search; all witnessed fine samples test support. Independent fine-lattice wood distances on changed triangles and a native-material needle/wood macro provide evidence. Does not claim exhaustive pixel/mip/wind coverage, full-tree quality or hardware performance.
